title: Build six untested Musts: Deep model warning, settings read-back and confirmation, demo screenshots
body:
Builds six Musts that had no test: RSC-08, CFG-01, CFG-03, CFG-04, CFG-08 and RES-05. The owner waived the feature-spec review and sign-off gates for this preview. The local drafts were used as designs, with the simplest option each recommended.

## Behavior
- **RSC-08, Deep model warning:** Deep work on a model that isn't `qualified` gets one `model-unqualified-for-deep` question, at `open` and before the first `check` after a later rise to Deep. `continue` covers this work and its current model record; `pause` parks the work. The label never changes and no other model is suggested.
- **CFG-01, settings read-back and confirmation:** `decide config` returns `data.interpreted`: the effective value before and after, when it takes effect, and how to undo it. Some project changes return a `config-confirm` question and save nothing until it is answered: loosening a protected path, exclusion, required check or dependency field; altering an existing required check; any command change. Answer `confirm` to save or `keep` to close the question.
- **CFG-03:** a command defined differently in the shared policy and the project is reported as a limit naming both.
- **CFG-04:** `style` and `resource_mode` say the kernel passes them to the coordinator and doesn't enforce them. "Why" about a setting goes to the settings view.
- **CFG-08:** a test proves the shared policy has no field for a preference, and that setting every preference at every scope changes no tracked file.
- **RES-05:** a `ui` demo can reference a screenshot the example's own check declares in `outputs`. Tenet lists it with its SHA-256 and never inspects what it shows. The build skill now tells the coordinator how to send the demo.

## Limits
- No qualification table exists, so every model is `unknown` and every Deep contract is asked. Deep reviewer and analyst packets aren't separately gated.
- Whether the host coordinator relays these questions is unobserved.
- `decide config` moved from `decisions/simple.ts` to `decisions/config.ts` because of the file's line cap.

Coverage after this PR: 157/181 Musts mapped, 16 host-only, 8 unmapped. None is qualified.

Tests: `model-qualification.test.ts`, `config-confirm.test.ts`, `personal-settings.test.ts`, `config.test.ts`, `result-demo.test.ts`, `deep.test.ts`. The real-repository tests run only on POSIX.
